deck_title: Azure AMD MI300X Large MoE BF16 vs MXFP4 Precision & Deployment Benchmark (7-Card Deck)

metadata.scope: Real-hardware validation of Muse Spark Open (816B-A42B), NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra (550B-A55B), and Thinking Machines Lab Inkling (975B-A41B) on Azure Standard_ND96isr_MI300X_v5 across BF16 and OCP-MXFP4
metadata.hardware_sku: Azure Standard_ND96isr_MI300X_v5 (8x AMD Instinct MI300X 192 GB HBM3 per node = 1,536 GB HBM3/node, gfx942)
metadata.key_finding: All 3 MoE models pass BF16 on MI300X (317.4-348.6 tok/s aggregate at C=8). In MXFP4, Nemotron 3 Ultra cuts weights 68.3% (136.51 -> 43.21 GiB/GPU) and Inkling halves hardware from 2 nodes (16 GPUs) to 1 node (8 GPUs, 66.74 GiB/GPU), but MI300X (gfx942) software FP4 emulation runs 5.8-7.5x slower (44.6-54.9 tok/s at C=8), whereas Muse Spark Open rejects EMULATION and requires gfx950 hardware FP4.

mi300x_model_census.hybrid_operators: Mamba-2 SSM + Attention + LatentMoE (non-gated relu2) + MTP
Local/Global Attention + ShortConv (264 sconv kernels) + 2 Shared Experts + MTP

mi300x_bf16_mxfp4_runs.critical_fix: Avoid muse-spark-open gfx950-only fused QK-norm/RoPE HIP kernel (SIGSEGV on gfx942)
Hard assertion in MuseSpark1x: rejects online quantization and requires native gfx950 AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4
Set VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0 for non-gated relu2 LatentMoE; omit stochastic rounding (PHILOX_ROUNDS ld.lld bug)
--quantization online --quantization-config '{"moe":"mxfp4"}' --moe-backend emulation (-68.3% weight RAM, 3.94x KV tokens)
NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=0 fixes 16-rank cross-node hang (52.4 GB/s all_reduce); TP8xPP2 respects sconv tp_size <= 8
Pre-quantized Quark MXFP4 checkpoint fits 975B model on 1x ND96isr_MI300X_v5 node (8 GPUs instead of 16)

decisions.question: Can 550B-A55B Nemotron 3 Ultra run in full BF16 on a single 8x MI300X node (1,536 GB HBM3)?
decisions.selected_answer: Yes: 136.51 GiB/GPU weights (TP8+EP8), 23.07 GiB free KV (3.49M tok), 317.4 tok/s @ C=8
decisions.closest_label: Online MoE MXFP4 shrinks weights to 43.21 GiB/GPU (-68.3%) and expands KV to 111.86 GiB (13.76M tok)

decisions.question: How should 975B-A41B Inkling (1,773.9 GiB BF16) be deployed across BF16 vs Quark OCP-MXFP4?
decisions.selected_answer: BF16: 2 Nodes (16x MI300X TP8xPP2, 335.8 tok/s) · MXFP4: 1 Node (8x MI300X TP8, 66.74 GiB/GPU)
decisions.closest_label: Quark MXFP4 halves hardware from 2 nodes to 1 node with 94.79 GiB/GPU free KV, at 44.6 tok/s (emulated)

decisions.question: Does Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B support OCP-MXFP4 on MI300X (CDNA3 / gfx942)?
decisions.selected_answer: No: vLLM MuseSpark1x requires native AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4 (gfx950 / MI355X) and rejects EMULATION
decisions.closest_label: Deploy Muse Spark Open in BF16 on 2x MI300X nodes (TP8xPP2, 99.1 GiB/GPU, 348.6 tok/s @ C=8)

callouts.lead: Azure Standard_ND96isr_MI300X_v5 Large MoE Validation (anonymized_reported, independently_reproduced=false).
callouts.body: Tested on Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS (kernel 6.8.0-1067-azure, ROCm 6.4.4-129) with 8x MI300X 192 GB HBM3 per node (1,536 GB/node).

cards.eyebrow: SCENARIO: 3 CRITICAL BRING-UP TRAPS & HBM3 BUDGET
cards.headline: Fixing gfx950 SIGSEGV, Non-Gated Relu2 MoE, and 2-Node RCCL Deadlocks.
cards.quote: Out-of-the-box container defaults failed on all three frontier MoEs: Muse Spark segfaulted in a gfx950-only HIP kernel, Nemotron crashed in AITER gated MoE, and Inkling hung for 240s on 16-rank cross-node RCCL until NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=0 was set.

decisions.question: Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B (62 layers, 256 experts top-8, 1,531.4 GiB BF16) on 2x MI300X nodes
decisions.closest_label: Avoids SIGSEGV in fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.hip compiled only for gfx950

decisions.question: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B-A55B (Mamba-2 + Attention + non-gated relu2 LatentMoE) on 1x MI300X node
decisions.selected_answer: Set VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0 -> TritonExperts + Triton Mamba SSU (float16 cache)
decisions.closest_label: Also omit --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding to avoid ld.lld PHILOX_ROUNDS target error

decisions.question: Inkling 975B-A41B (66 layers, 264 ShortConv kernels, 256 routed + 2 shared experts) on 2x/1x MI300X
decisions.selected_answer: Set NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=0 + TP8xPP2 (BF16 2-Node) or TP8 Quark MXFP4 (1-Node)
decisions.closest_label: TP16 fails sconv tp_size <= num_kv_heads (8); TP8xDP2+EP16 hangs in remote DP coordinator RPC

callouts.lead: Single-expert NVFP4 numerical verification on MI300X passed with < 1e-8 relative L2 error.
callouts.body: Nvfp4QuantizationEmulationTritonExperts recorded 0.0 relative L2 error on Nemotron-3-Ultra-NVFP4 and 3.74e-9 on Inkling-NVFP4 (threshold <= 0.02).

callouts.lead: 5 of 6 main model x precision cells pass on MI300X; all 3 models pass in native BF16.
callouts.body: Rows marked (✕) show the exact container/kernel traps resolved during bring-up and the single unsupported MXFP4 cell (Muse Spark Open on gfx942).

callouts.lead: MXFP4 on MI300X is a memory-density & node-consolidation mode, not a throughput booster.
callouts.body: Because CDNA3 (gfx942) emulates FP4 in Triton software, MXFP4 cuts weights by 50–68% and halves Inkling from 16 to 8 GPUs, but runs 5.8–7.5x slower than BF16.

cards.headline: Deploy BF16 for Production Throughput on MI300X; Use MXFP4 for 1-Node Density
good_fit: 1-node 550B BF16 production serving: Nemotron 3 Ultra on 1x ND96isr_MI300X_v5 (TP8+EP8, 136.51 GiB/GPU) delivers 60.7 tok/s (C=1) and 317.4 tok/s (C=8)
2-node 816B–975B BF16 serving: Muse Spark Open (348.6 tok/s @ C=8) and Inkling (335.8 tok/s @ C=8, 45 ms TTFT) via Ray TP8 x PP2 with NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=0
1-node 975B hardware consolidation: Quark MXFP4 fits Inkling 975B on a single 8-GPU MI300X node (66.74 GiB/GPU, 94.79 GiB free KV) for functional/batch evaluation
Ultra-large KV cache residency: Nemotron online MoE MXFP4 unlocks 111.86 GiB/GPU KV cache (13.76M tokens across 8 GPUs)
not_for: Interactive low-latency serving with MXFP4 on MI300X (gfx942 software FP4 emulation drops C=1 decode to 6.1–7.7 tok/s; use MI355X gfx950 or Blackwell for native FP4 speed)
Running Muse Spark Open in MXFP4 on MI300X (MuseSpark1x rejects EMULATION and requires native AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4)
Running TP16 or default GDR on 2-node Inkling 975B (sconv requires tp_size <= 8; default GDR hangs 16-rank RCCL)
Using default AITER MoE on Nemotron 3 Ultra without VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0 (non-gated relu2 incompatibility)
